statement: A record whose normalized status is `rejected` yields foreclosure intent (REC-104): retained and queryable, never counted toward trusted evidence, and never presented as something the team does (REC-032).

valid_case.description: Directory of 2 records: one accepted, one rejected. Under REC-104 BOTH are retained — the accepted one as ground-truth intent, the rejected one as foreclosure intent, which must never be counted toward trust nor presented as something the team does.

invalid_case.description: A non-conformant implementation that DROPS the rejected record entirely destroys the record of a decision explicitly taken against, which is the answer to 'have we already declined this?'.
invalid_case.reason: 0002-rejected.md's status normalises to 'rejected' (see REC-006). Including it promotes an explicitly-not-chosen option to ground truth.

note: Ingesting this directory yields two decision nodes: the accepted record as ground-truth intent and the rejected one as foreclosure intent.
